content:
Maya: CI alert — integration-tests failing on runtime guide snippet. Failing assertion points to example env var names. https://kb.internal/runtime-guide#env
Sam: repro'd locally. The example uses REDWOOD_RUNTIME_MODE but tests expect RUNTIME_MODE. quick mismatch from a doc copy-paste.
Maya: ugh. Anyone listed as owner for that page? eng-docs-bot, can you show owners?
eng-docs-bot: Owners for /runtime-guide: none listed. Last frontmatter edit by Elle 4 days ago.
Elle: that was me — I changed some examples in PR #4321 but I must've missed the env var normalization.
Sam: for a fast unblock I can sed the test to accept both vars, but that's awkward. prefer patching the docs to match the canonical env var mapping.
Maya: agree — patch docs. Also we should add a one-line regression test so CI catches mismatches.
Elle: I'll open a tiny PR to update the snippet and add a short test harness that verifies the snippet compiles/run (shell check). I'll also add myself as owner in frontmatter.
Alex: if you're editing, can you also add a deprecation note about the old REDWOOD_* prefix? we've had confusion before.
Elle: sure. Proposed patch (will link PR):
```
# BEFORE
export REDWOOD_RUNTIME_MODE=hosted
# AFTER
# canonical
export RUNTIME_MODE=hosted
# alias kept for legacy
export REDWOOD_RUNTIME_MODE=${RUNTIME_MODE}
```
Sam: that looks reasonable. For the regression test, simple bash snippet to source the file and assert RUNTIME_MODE is set.
Maya: please include the test under docs/tests/snippets to keep it discoverable. Also add a short changelog entry in the PR description.
Elle: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — includes snippet fix, frontmatter owner add, and tiny tests.
Alex: quick review done, left one nit about wording. lgtm pending nit.
Sam: CI on the PR failed due to lint flake, pushing a tiny commit to fix line length.
Elle: updated. CI is green now.
Maya: thanks — will you merge once CI stays green? I can then re-run the integration suite.
Elle: merged and tagged. commit: 7f4c9a2
Sam: re-ran integration-tests locally against main — all green. I'll queue a full CI run shortly.
Maya: full CI passed. Closing the loop, thanks everyone :tada:
Alex: nice one — saved an application test from being noisy in prod deploys.
doc-owners: note - runtime-guide now has owner: Elle added. Please reassign if needed.
Maya: Filed a short follow-up ticket to audit other runtime snippets for REDWOOD_ prefix. cc @doc-owners
Sam: I'll grab that audit next sprint.
